scope: Compact source/logic review of IDEA000024, IDEA000025, IDEA000026 and IDEA000033, with the IDEA000019 unit addendum carried forward. No scientific review append, build, corpus run or registry mutation.

source_evidence.quote:
The role decision is substantially stronger than either noun. That is useful,
not a retreat: the renderer always has a practical default, while the evidence
table says exactly which part may later change. Neither result comes from
reading EVA `f` as *flos* or EVA `s` as *semen*.

The guarded cache contains 25 exact `ofch*` occurrences across thirteen
complete forms and thirteen exact `*fchy` occurrences across eight forms. This
supports a real formal neighborhood but not automatic composition. The only
semantic bridge is deliberately weak: one scoped `ofchedy` card already reads
“fully dried flower mass.” GDT765 uses that as a whole-family analogy to choose
**Blütenmasse** over the close rival **Blütenzubereitung**; it does not create
an `ofch = flower` component.

This is not a translation. It is a more informative renderer and a concrete
route toward meaning: the prose is no longer ownerless, but the picture is not
pretended to decode every word.

This supports panel-level ownership. It does not by itself identify the
language or turn label count into syntax.

These are useful working semantics for the *observed whole labels in their
image contexts*. They do not license `d`, `ot`, `ol`, `dy`, `sy` or `aiin` as
free dictionary entries. In particular, this panel set gives no reason to call
`ol` “water” or “oil”: ol-like forms label figures, arch endpoints and station
zones as well as liquid-looking structures.

reviews.title: A fixed whole changes role with argument position, not meaning

blockers.detail: The proposal contrasts action-slot and material/property-slot roles, but does not yet freeze which neighboring field tags are independent rather than inherited working labels.

A fixed meaning can legitimately show different neighbor profiles by construction or context; a slot interaction alone does not establish meaning change. Preserve the structural interaction as exploratory.

reviews.source_logic: GDT765 explicitly says the role decision can be stronger than the noun and that the whole-family analogy does not create an EVA component (lines 12-15, 36-42). Thus the smallest legitimate question is whether independently typed neighbor fields predict a role-conditioned structural distribution; it cannot be framed as proving two meanings.

reviews.title: Owner-conditioned whole forms select local referents

blockers.detail: The owner interaction needs a frozen complete-whole identity, exact owner, successor unit and matched register/position strata.
Owner-conditioned context can change successor distributions while the whole keeps one fixed object meaning; an owner interaction is not by itself a local-referent or lexical claim.

reviews.source_logic: GDT790 reports a panel-owner layer while stating it is not a translation (lines 23-25) and that panel ownership does not identify language or syntax (lines 53-54). This preserves a valid owner-conditioned structural association but blocks automatic referent meaning.

reviews.title: Panel-local deictic forms reset at visual panel boundaries

blockers.detail: The panel boundary, candidate whole, within-panel continuation and native owner must be frozen before a reset contrast is defined.
A referent can reset because discourse or panel ownership changes even when the candidate is not deictic. Boundary interaction therefore tests reset behavior, not deictic lexical meaning by itself.

reviews.source_logic: GDT790's owner overlay supports panel-level structure but explicitly refuses translation and dictionary export (lines 23-25, 96-100). A panel-reset observation may be retained as structural evidence with a generic opener/discourse-reset rival.

reviews.title: A source marker separates reported from directly observed content

blockers.detail: The source/report status coding, candidate whole and matched register/field controls are not frozen in the imported design.
Provenance association can arise from topic, lexical content or record type; a generic null must be justified against those alternatives rather than assumed.

reviews.source_logic: The inspected primary evidence supports cautious whole-form and panel-context observations, not a source-status lexicon: GDT790 says observed whole labels do not license free dictionary entries (lines 96-100). A provenance contrast needs independent source-status endpoints and a content/topic null.

reviews.title: A modifier whole scopes over the next head only

blockers.detail: The proposed unit is a complete modifier whole, whereas the cited GDT575/GDT577 source packets expose analyst atom slots inside event decompositions.

The 75 replayed bindings and exploratory O/D_ADDR attachments are not established here as independent complete-whole modifier/head gold. Raw-whole-to-slot mapping must precede the 70% or +20-point test.

reviews.source_logic: Retain the structural question, but do not promote attachment defaults or renderer success to complete-whole scope or semantic evidence. This carries forward jj_scope_unit_addendum.json.

overall: All five designs remain method-level, not_tested. The valid exploratory objects are role-by-slot association, owner interaction, panel reset and provenance interaction; none licenses an automatic lexical or referent claim without the scoped bindings above.
